decision.reason: The highest-ranked logistic setting regressed overall and in both languages.

limitations: TRAIN-only cross-validation used to select C; not independent or final evaluation.
Only 15 manually reviewed semantic clusters; subtype and class support differ across folds.
Authored language, shared task semantics and prior development-guided training expansion limit generalization claims.
Confidence remains uncalibrated; no threshold or out-of-distribution rejection search was performed.
Raw intent scoring does not assess record grounding, workflow completion, consent, access safety or handoff usefulness.
Component fit time includes validation, and the first linear fit includes cold optional dependency imports.
Inference timings exclude startup, output serialization, UI, network, human time and deployment.
Earlier short-message diagnostics were not rerun; their percentages are not directly comparable with these folds.
No sealed final cases, old development messages, private source records, PDFs, deployments or publication were used.
